name: DenFur
blurb: Colorado's largest furry fandom convention, held in Denver with panels, dances, an art show and a dealers den.
notes: denfur.org itself returned a persistent Cloudflare bot-check (status 403) on every attempt (direct, --channel msedge, and a Wayback Machine snapshot all showed the same 'Just a moment...' challenge, so even archive.org's crawler appears to have been blocked), so the homepage could never be rendered directly. Dates/venue/cover sourced instead from DenFur's own Eventeny listing (explicitly tagged 'Event from https://denfur.org'), which carries JSON-LD confirming 2026-08-28 to 2026-08-30 at the Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel, Denver CO -- corroborated by fancons.com, 10times.com and a fursuitcommissions.com recap. That edition ended before the research window (2026-10-05), so it is recorded as "last" only. DenFur 2027 is confirmed (via search; official site unreachable) for August 2027 with a 'Video Games' theme, but no specific dates have been announced yet, so editions is empty. Organizer taken from the Eventeny listing ('Organized by AEI 501(c)(3)'); not independently confirmed on the (unreachable) official site. Re-check once denfur.org is reachable again.
